english.title: Kill animal according to religious rites without prior stunning, immediate incision and back-up
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person]_

engaged in the killing of a

(C)_[sheep]_
(D)_[goat]_
(E)_[bovine animal]_

in accordance with religious rites without prior stunning failed to ensure that

(F)_[it was not placed in restraining equipment unless the person who was to carry out the killing was ready to make the incision immediately after it was placed in the equipment]_
(G)_[appropriate back-up stunning equipment was kept close to the restraining equipment for use in case of emergency and was immediately used where it was subjected to avoidable pain, suffering or agitation or had any injuries or contusions]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(e) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 6(1) of Schedule 3 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
